scientific_integrity: Two complete exact calculations agree, using signed bipartite permanents and recursive matching incidence plus the Walsh transform; no sampling, probabilistic argument, or independent external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact 16-vertex Q4 calculation only; gauge theory and matching count are known, complete histogram and norm require a finite exhaustive arithmetic certificate. No general formula for higher cube dimension. Inaccessible earlier full enumeration may carry unindexed overlap risk.
title: Exact signed-dimer Fourier spectrum and sharp recovery projection on the four-cube
